svg.aria-label: Horizon UI: immersive sky gradient with a daily alert, an interactive sky calendar of important events, a tappable hourly outlook and expandable glass detail tiles
svg.text: Swift meteors from Halley's Comet, best in the hours before dawn.
Best window: 06:00–07:00 (clear sky, 24°C, 0% rain chance, score 85/100).
Look up for sunrise at 06:08, a New Moon, and Andromeda and Pegasus
riding high overhead. A very good morning to step outside.
Put the phone in your pocket at 06:00, step outside,
and give the sky two unhurried minutes.
Up to ~20 meteors/hour at the peak. Swift meteors from Halley's
Comet, best in the hours before dawn. Look towards Orion.
